frozen_design.expected_software: Parent/runtime source hashes unchanged; root separately verified Torch2.11.0, vLLM0.26, Triton3.6 and migrated model. Actual environment.json remains authoritative.
frozen_design.output_contract: Same256 request IDs, arrivals, prompt tokens and declared fixed min=max output counts with ignoreEOS. Counts do not establish identical content/routing/computation/quality.
frozen_design.resource_policy: Reuse prior explicit1.5GiB root reserve plus.5GiB tmpfs trace/log reserve (2GiB total),500MiB own trace/log ceiling,Hostheadroom>=2GiB. Root native caches/TMPDIR unchanged;no compiler cache migration. Existing sharedlock/inode/device/driver/afterlockidlechecks at boundaries. No new paid resources or cost-balance telemetry.
frozen_design.primary_objective: U=number of all arrived requests meeting TTFT4s/per-requestmaxgap100ms/completion20s divided by full elapsed including drain/control/client lag. Thresholds are preexisting research assumptions, not validated production SLOs. Never retune them after outcomes.
frozen_design.uncertainty: Onlytwoepisodesperfixedchoice ononealreadyseendevelopmenttrace; reportpairsseparately andpooledsumqualified/sumelapsed onlyasdescription. Concurrentfixed1024repeatdrift contextualizes effects; oldsame-policyUdrifts.153%,.685%,1.973% are not a noise distribution/CI or replacementgainthreshold. Do not use256requests as independentrepeats or declare significance/equivalence.
frozen_design.name: D OA-style known-prefill deadline-demand baseline
frozen_design.question: Can ordinary known-prefill demand density improve complete service over current fixed1024, or does deferred prefill/changed average work still explain the outcome?
frozen_design.evidence: On this device fixed512 cuts generation span about2s but adds about2.5s TTFT; it rescues16 early long qualifications yet loses50/51 later ones. A latest-output100ms deadline screen saturates at maximum total budget. Existing F decision snapshots show cumulative-prefix demands selecting1024 vs head-only512 on46/54 steps. These CPU suggestions do not establish alternate trajectory performance.
frozen_design.classification: OA/EDF-style ordinary strong-simple baseline adaptation, not a new scheduling principle or full Niyama/SLOWeave reproduction. Yao-Demers-Shenker FOCS1995 Optimal Available is direct demand-density precedent; Niyama official code has per-request prefill-throughput/TTFT feasibility relegation.
frozen_design.policy: Current unfinished prefills in native running then waiting order; deadline=external_arrival+4. Required rate=max prefix remaining prompt work divided by that prefix deadline slack. Enumerate pure caps512/1024/2048; effectiveP=min(cap,backlog); choose minimum cap with effectiveP/(1.2*existing_current_state_host_step_model)>=required_rate.
frozen_design.exceptional_behavior: Any overdue pending TTFT deadline, no feasible cap or invalid/nonpositive candidate model cost chooses2048 for continued progress and records the reason. No backlog chooses1024. No special D=0 rule. No skip/drop/reorder/admission change, output-length or future-arrival input.
frozen_design.model: Unchanged two-regime Niyama artifact fit, branch effectiveP+D<=512 or>512; physicalD, sourceCd=sum(num_computed+1), head-prefill computed context. No refit/profile/newpredictor. Fluid service rate with current-state cost is a heuristic, not a discrete-time or future-state SLO guarantee.
frozen_design.controls: Same native parent component episode and pure-cap patch, fixed external256 arrivals/prompts/generation contract, model/BF16/normalKV/native4096total/maxseq192. Fixed arm avoids candidate demand/prediction computation; required shared observation and every policy own CPU control cost remains in elapsed. No extra forward/synchronization/kernel/cache changes.
frozen_design.warmup: Three full fixed workloads512/1024/2048 plus one demand workload before formal. Each fixed warm must contain actualP=itscap. No extra warm retry; inspect formal compile/capture/autotune. This covers used tiers, not identical batch/kernel states.
frozen_design.decision: Use unchanged U research contract and report both effects, qualification additions/losses, full elapsed/throughput/TTFT/flow/maxgap/control/lag/drain and affected requests. No universal gain percentage/all-metric-improvement gates. Consistent interpretable U improvement is ordinary-baseline development evidence only; before innovation require matched-mean fixed and head-only controls. Tiny/mixed effects remain uncertain with no automatic repetition. A lowerU tradeoff is reported but does not establish this method objective.
frozen_design.stopping: At most4warm+4formal, one waiter<=7200s,180s/cell plus init/storage, no automatic retry/refit/cap/threshold scan. After first F/D pair stop before reverse if no actual changed cap binding. Preserve partial failures. If no useful full-service signal, close this OA mapping; do not immediately add a more complex predictor.
frozen_design.stage_budget: One group, expected8-12minutes GPU from49-53s known episodes; at most8episodes, raw/log<=500MiB, root1.5GiB plus tmpfs.5GiB and effectiveHost>=2GiB guards. Whole-group lock released at terminal before readback/analysis. No expense telemetry or new paid resources.

resource_resumption.scope: One separately frozen resource-resumption entry. Preserve01; no scientific change, weakened resource gate, automatic launch or retry. Actual submission requires new resource evidence and no other D task.

scope: Ordinary deadline-demand baseline development comparison, not a novelty or significance claim. Primary4s/100ms/20s is a research contract without established production justification. COMPLETE_EXPLORATORY means complete valid4formal+4warm, driverCOMPLETE and fixedwarm actual512/1024/2048 coverage; it does not require old3%/5% performance gates or actual intervention. All requests, failed attempts, output divergence, arrival/add lag, full elapsed/drain and control/model diagnostics are retained. Full elapsed is the denominator; pooled descriptions do not override pair signs. Fixed output counts do not establish equal content/routes/computation/quality. No automatic winner, continuation or retry.
